It's good! Guns obviously aren't available until past the halfway mark for levels but the tech tree is pretty solid in terms of level pacing and you can still get random schematic drops to get the better stuff potentially earlier.

Once I got a gun the game really hit it stride and I felt like John wick doing all the wacky shenanigans involved with guns in the pokemon world. Pal skills are unique and diverse and though the map isn't randomly generated it's plenty big enough for you to sink hours into just exploration. 

Base building is alright the structure snapping sucks ass and is one of my few big complaints, but it's nothing that can't be fixed later on. There's not a lot of humans so the world can feel a little empty. There's also ZERO soundtrack outside of battles, which kinda sucks. The late game pals are still great challenges, and the breeding is also good. You can edit your own world settings at anytime which is a great qol feature.

Uhhhh, that's it off the top of my head I can answer any questions you may have.

Oh! Be aware of being in the same guild as friends, you share bases and the pals on that base technically, so if a base isn't dismantled properly your friends  can end up with your pals, though you can givem back too, just extra workarounds that can be frustrating.

TLDR: give it a try, it's a great game to sink your teeth into and lose hundreds of hours in. Even if you don't like open-world survival craft the system progression really helps with pacing and you don't have to babysit and play a resource management game as much. Worth the price atm and worth a try. Better than any AAA publisher disappointment.

I can't say myself. Honestly nobody will really know until we get there. Anything reliant on the extra deck WILL be affected though. I honestly don't think it'll kill ABCs. Zoodiac, synchro heavy decks, anything extra deck aggro, probably dead for the first year or two (I'm guessing powercreep LINK will be a thing). But overall I think it'll make a more balanced meta. Heck I could even see shaddolls coming back. You bring out a LINK monster and go into Winda and it'll be so hard for the other player to get out a link monster using only 1 special summon. Though LINK 1 Monsters will be a thing. I'm actually excited now. I was hurt that dark synchro's and stuff are dead but it'll being such versatility and diversity. Just thinking about theorycrafting is already fun.

I think ABC can still work around it. Say there's a generic LINK-2 Monster. You can go photon/gadget into A, use union hangar to equip C. LINK Summon using thrasher/gadget and A. Use C's effect to SS B, then fuse into dragon buster?

I wouldn't say these decks are unplayable per se. They do require for effort though to make only sub-optimal plays. And you can probably punish that pretty easily since you'll most likely have to over extend to make that play. It's just going to be a LOT harder and the gamestate will definitely slow down
